inputs: linear and quadratic drag only; explicit added-mass coefficients remain zero

serialized_values.fluid_added_mass_path: SDF link/inertial/fluid_added_mass; solved by gz-physics DART spatial inertia

allocation_policy.name: coupled-envelope-yaw-priority-v1
allocation_policy.rule: Bound yaw first to the physically deliverable +/-46.2 N m, then allocate equal surge from the symmetric per-thruster force headroom remaining inside +/-70 N per thruster.
allocation_policy.rationale: For waypoint transit, preserving heading correction is required to recover the route; reduced forward speed remains useful progress. This is an explicit controller-allocation design decision, not a manufacturer-specified behavior.
allocation_policy.provenance: Campaign correction after the inherited generic +/-100 N m yaw command bound was shown to clip allocation on 85.2% of a five-episode diagnostic replay.

out_of_plane_vrx_damping.classification: reviewed engineering estimate; not manufacturer data, measured Surveyor data, or Node planar3 parity data
out_of_plane_vrx_damping.method: Twenty-five percent of linearized critical damping, c = 2*zeta*sqrt(m_eff*k), with zeta=0.25 selected as a conventional moderate-underdamping design assumption before runtime testing.

derivation.heave: k=10195 N/m from Surface waterplane slope and m=52.3 kg gives c=365 N s/m.
derivation.roll: k=1112 N m/rad and assembled Ixx=5.375 kg m2 gives c=38.7 N m s/rad, rounded to 40.
derivation.pitch: The discrete Surface points at +/-L/4 give k=2080 N m/rad, 75% of the continuous-waterplane stiffness because (L/4)^2/(L^2/12)=0.75. With assembled Iyy=13.347 kg m2, c=83.3 N m s/rad, rounded to 85.

limitations: The damping ratio is an engineering design assumption without a Surveyor-specific literature or measurement source.
Replace these values if free-decay or manufacturer measurements become available.

assembly_mass_partition.reason: Rotor child-link mass and parallel-axis inertia are partitioned out of the established totals so the assembled model remains exactly 52.3 kg with zero first moment and the established aggregate inertia tensor.

surface_points_sdf_flu_m.reason: Symmetric fore/aft quadrature points at +/- one quarter of the established 1.83 m pontoon length provide pitch-restoring buoyancy; no WAM-V coordinate is used.

rotor_engineering_estimate.classification: documented engineering estimate; not SR-Surveyor, manufacturer, or WAM-V data

reasoning.mass: 0.30 kg is centered within the defensible 0.20-0.50 kg range for compact marine propeller/rotor assemblies in this power class.
reasoning.diameter: 0.10 m diameter gives a 0.05 m radius, a few-centimetre radius appropriate to a compact roughly 1 kW pocket thruster.
reasoning.transverse_inertia: Short-cylinder approximation I=0.25*m*r^2 + m*t^2/12 with estimated 0.02 m axial thickness = 0.0001975 kg m^2.
reasoning.damping: Viscous-equivalent damping c=P/omega^2 at 1000 W and 3000 rpm = 0.010132118364233778 N m s/rad; this represents rated-point hydrodynamic rotational dissipation without claiming a manufacturer curve.
reasoning.thrust_coefficient: Gazebo force-mode identity Kt=T/(rho*D^4*omega^2), using the established 70 N bound, rho=1025 kg/m^3, D=0.10 m and 3000 rpm, gives 0.006919495468257212. The plugin command remains clamped at exactly +/-70 N, so the estimate does not alter thrust authority.

rotor_engineering_estimate.comparable_power_class_reference: Blue Robotics T500 product documentation describes a compact flooded thruster operating just over 1 kW; used only to support the broad power-class analogy, not to copy its physical parameters.

provenance_statement: Established hull, mass, inertia, damping, actuator placement, lag and force bounds are serialized from the Surveyor source artifact, never bcod_usv. Only explicitly labeled rotor values are engineering estimates; no WAM-V rotor number is used.

environment.note: VRX libraries and their dependent libWaves.so must both be discoverable.

equal_thrust_test.assessment: Strong positive surge with negligible lateral displacement and yaw; small bounded roll/pitch.

axis_and_serialization_check.joint_type: revolute (supported by the pinned DART build)
axis_and_serialization_check.port_starboard_y_conversion: NED body y is negated for SDF FLU
axis_and_serialization_check.surface_point_fix: Each pontoon uses symmetric fore/aft points; a single center point had no pitch-restoring moment.

vrx-episode-driver.ts is only a re-export; no lifecycle connects seeded reset, 1200 control messages, and 2400 odometry samples.
The Surveyor VRX world has no serialized wind/current systems, so contract reset disturbances cannot be applied.
The existing Jazzy exporter consumes odometry but no checked-in orchestrator synchronizes it with deterministic simulation stepping.
